propositions: Data Center backend has no value-level characterization suite, only shape-level contract tests that would pass with every value wrong
The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised only through AdfCodec in existing tests, never through WikiTextCodec, leaving DC composition regressions undetected

Data Center's separate implementations (_DCOutbound, _DCInbound, _DCSanitizer, _map_local_to_dc_fields) require pinning of every emitted key's value, sanitizer boundaries, identity label form, and probe classification branches
The probe classification seam through FakeTransport cannot reach real probe branches because FakeTransport.probe_remote unconditionally returns ProbeBranch.UNREACHABLE
Data Center must bind its own configured resolved_statuses rather than Cloud's, but this is unobservable at default configuration because both sets are byte-identical
